---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(plotly)
peaks <- data.frame(
  name = c("Everest","K2","Kangchenjunga","Lhotse","Makalu","Denali","Aconcagua","Kilimanjaro","Elbrus","Mont Blanc","Fuji"),
  range = c("Himalaya","Karakoram","Himalaya","Himalaya","Himalaya","Alaska","Andes","Africa","Caucasus","Alps","Japan"),
  height = c(8849,8611,8586,8516,8485,6190,6961,5895,5642,4806,3776),
  prominence = c(8849,4020,3922,610,2386,6144,6961,5885,4741,4695,3776)
)
```

## Overview

- Presentation built with **R Markdown** (ioslides) and **Plotly**
- Created on **`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`**
- Next slides: interactive plots – hover, zoom and click the legend

## Peak heights

```{r bar}
plot_ly(peaks[order(peaks$height),], x = ~height, y = ~reorder(name, height),
        type = "bar", orientation = "h", color = ~range,
        text = ~paste(height, "m"), hoverinfo = "text+y",
        width = 850, height = 420) %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Height (m)"), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

## Height vs. prominence

```{r scatter}
plot_ly(peaks, x = ~height, y = ~prominence, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        color = ~range, size = ~height, sizes = c(10, 50),
        text = ~name, hoverinfo = "text+x+y", width = 850, height = 420) %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Height (m)"), yaxis = list(title = "Prominence (m)"))
```
